queries.embedding_query: 7-month-old dog puppy dry kibble for active young dogs, small-to-medium kibble for brachycephalic muzzle, balanced protein and fat with moderate calorie density for weight control, adult-transition/large-breed growth formula, Mars-brand options, 15–30 lb bag
queries.bm25_query: puppy dry kibble small medium bite balanced protein moderate calories adult-transition Mars NOT duck
queries.rationale: Daily primary nutrition  AJ needs a reliable daily kibble formulated for growth and high activity. As a 7-month-old pug at 40 lb, feeding an appropriate kibble every day is essential for growth, energy and weight management. Must avoid duck due to allergy.

queries.embedding_query: 7-month-old dog soft training treats, pea-sized low-calorie soft/moist texture for frequent rewards, easily breakable pieces, resealable small packs, fast-to-eat for training sessions
queries.bm25_query: soft training treats pea-sized low-calorie breakable resealable small pack NOT duck
queries.rationale: At 7 months AJ is still in intensive training/socialization. Frequent small rewards are used daily to reinforce good behavior. Soft low-calorie treats reduce calorie load while enabling many repetitions. Avoid duck due to allergy.

queries.embedding_query: 7-month-old dog heavy-duty stainless steel non-tip water bowl, rubber base, wide-mouth 48–64 oz capacity, dishwasher-safe and rust-resistant, stable spill-proof design for apartment use
queries.bm25_query: stainless steel non-tip water bowl wide-mouth 48-64oz dishwasher-safe rubber base stable NOT duck
queries.rationale: Daily water is essential. A sturdy non-tip steel bowl ensures AJ has fresh water every day and reduces spills in an apartment. Steel is hygienic and durable for a heavy, active dog.

queries.embedding_query: 7-month-old dog collapsible travel water bottle with attached bowl, leak-proof 20–28 oz capacity, lightweight, easy-clean, carabiner for leash attachment for walks and yard visits
queries.bm25_query: collapsible travel water bottle attached bowl 20-28oz leak-proof carabiner easy-clean NOT duck
queries.rationale: Excessive heat warning + AJ's brachycephalic breed increase heat-risk during outings. Having on-walk hydration available immediately prevents dehydration and heat emergency  essential when leaving the apartment or using the yard.

queries.embedding_query: 7-month-old dog evaporative or ice-pack compatible cooling vest sized for short-legged brachycephalic body, adjustable straps, reflective trim, machine-washable lightweight material for walk safety
queries.bm25_query: cooling vest evaporative ice-pack adjustable straps reflective brachycephalic machine-washable NOT duck
queries.rationale: Pugs are highly heat-sensitive (brachycephalic). With an active dog and an excessive heat warning, a cooling vest for walks is an immediate safety item to reduce risk of heat stress during outdoor exercise.

queries.embedding_query: 7-month-old dog heavy-duty chew toy made from indestructible rubber or tough nylon, low-fragmentation non-toxic construction, sized for strong chewers, treat-insertion capable for solo chewing
queries.bm25_query: heavy-duty chew toy indestructible rubber nylon non-toxic low-fragmentation treat-capable strong chewer NOT duck
queries.rationale: AJ is a strong chewer and energeticwithout durable chew options he may destroy household items and ingest hazardous materials. A robust chew toy reduces immediate safety hazards and provides daily outlet for chewing behavior.

queries.embedding_query: 7-month-old dog deshedding tool or undercoat rake for short-coated breeds, firm bristles, ergonomic handle, washable or replaceable head to capture loose seasonal hair
queries.bm25_query: deshedding tool undercoat rake short coat firm bristles ergonomic washable head NOT duck
queries.rationale: Fall shedding season is active and pugs shed significantly. Regular deshedding reduces hair in the apartment and reduces allergen load for the household; timely grooming prevents matting and skin irritation.

queries.embedding_query: 7-month-old dog hypoallergenic grooming wipes, fragrance-free, alcohol-free, pH-balanced, for sensitive skin and pollen/dust removal, individually wrapped or resealable packets for quick cleanups
queries.bm25_query: hypoallergenic grooming wipes fragrance-free alcohol-free pH-balanced individual packets NOT duck
queries.rationale: Allergy season is active and AJ is in a region with fall allergens. Wipes help remove allergens from coat/paws after outdoor time and reduce sneezing/itching, supporting comfort and preventing secondary skin problems.

queries.embedding_query: 7-month-old dog dog toothbrush (finger or dual-head) and enzymatic toothpaste safe to ingest, palatable flavor (non-duck), travel-size kit for daily home brushing
queries.bm25_query: dog toothbrush enzymatic toothpaste safe ingestion palatable travel-size NOT duck
queries.rationale: Dental care is recommended to begin around 68 months. Regular brushing reduces plaque buildup and future dental disease. As AJ is approaching adulthood, starting daily/regular brushing now is preventive care.

queries.embedding_query: 7-month-old dog slow feeder maze bowl, low-profile for brachycephalic head shape, dishwasher-safe plastic or ceramic to reduce gulping and improve digestion
queries.bm25_query: slow feeder maze bowl low-profile brachycephalic dishwasher-safe plastic ceramic anti-gulping NOT duck
queries.rationale: Pugs can gulp quickly which increases risk of digestive upset. A slow feeder reduces rapid eating, lowering bloat/aspiration/regurgitation risk and improving mealtime behavior.

queries.embedding_query: 7-month-old dog front-clip no-pull harness, reinforced construction for strong pullers, padded chest panel for brachycephalic chest, adjustable sizing and reflective trim for low-light safety
queries.bm25_query: front-clip no-pull harness reinforced padded chest brachycephalic adjustable reflective NOT duck
queries.rationale: AJ is very strong and active; a no-pull harness reduces leash-pulling and improves safety on walks. Reflective trim helps during low-light walks (hunting season & early mornings).

queries.embedding_query: 7-month-old dog rechargeable LED clip-on safety light or reflective collar band, lightweight, attachable to collar or harness, multiple modes (steady and blink) for nighttime visibility
queries.bm25_query: LED clip-on safety light reflective collar band rechargeable multiple-modes lightweight NOT duck
queries.rationale: Hunting season and variable daylight, plus apartment neighborhood walks, increase risk during low-light hours. Visibility gear reduces risk of accidents and improves owner confidence on outdoor trips.

queries.embedding_query: 7-month-old dog passive cooling mat or self-cooling pad sized for a medium dog, non-electric gel or pressure-activated, washable cover for indoor apartment use
queries.bm25_query: cooling mat passive gel self-cooling pad medium washable cover indoor NOT duck
queries.rationale: With excessive heat periods, an indoor cooling surface helps AJ regulate body temp while resting inside and reduces heat stress between outdoor activities.

queries.bm25_query: paw wax balm protective dog boots non-slip small medium paw conditioning hot pavement NOT duck
queries.rationale: During heat alerts, pavement and outdoor surfaces can become too hot for paw pads. Paw wax or boots are preventive to avoid burns and soreness during walks or yard play.

queries.bm25_query: 20-30ft long training line swivel clip reflective durable recall training NOT duck

queries.bm25_query: teething chew toys textured rubber woven rope softer durable puppy NOT duck

queries.bm25_query: treat-dispensing puzzle toy adjustable difficulty durable hide kibble mental stimulation NOT duck
queries.rationale: As a high-energy, intelligent young dog, AJ benefits from mental stimulation to reduce boredom and destructive behaviors, especially while indoors in an apartment or during rainy days.

queries.bm25_query: flirt pole durable cord secure lure replaceable compact yard sprint chase NOT duck
queries.rationale: AJ is very energetic; a flirt pole provides high-intensity bursts of exercise safely in yard or open areas, burning energy and improving impulse control when indoor/outdoor time is limited.

queries.bm25_query: durable rubber fetch ball high-bounce medium size non-toxic floatable aggressive chewer NOT duck

queries.bm25_query: snuffle mat fabric hide kibble machine-washable apartment scent work NOT duck

queries.bm25_query: heavy-duty tug rope reinforced two-person knotted chew-safe fibers medium large mouth NOT duck
queries.rationale: Interactive tug supports bonding, outlet for high energy, and controlled play sessions which are important for a strong, energetic young dog living in an apartment with yard access.

queries.rationale: Hunting season and leaf blower noise windows are stress-inducing in the calendar context. A pheromone product can reduce noise-related anxiety episodes and make AJ more comfortable at home.

queries.bm25_query: small hide-board tabletop puzzle kibble paw nose manipulation compact easy reset NOT duck
